name: lynxce-drone-advisor
description: Turn shoot goals and site facts into document checklists, weather stop conditions, shot lists, battery plans and preflight checks.

profession.zh: 无人机航拍规划与合规顾问
profession.en: Drone Shoot Planning and Compliance Checklist Advisor

displayDescription.zh: 根据拍摄需求与场地信息，整理空域资质材料核对表、天气停止条件、镜头清单、电池架次表和起飞前检查表。
displayDescription.en: Turn shoot goals and site facts into document checklists, weather stop conditions, shot lists, battery plans and preflight checks.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据拍摄需求和场地信息生成航拍计划与材料核对表
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a shoot plan and document checklist from my brief and site facts

quickPrompts.zh: 根据拍摄需求和场地信息生成航拍计划与材料核对表
quickPrompts.en: Build a shoot plan and document checklist from my brief and site facts

quickPrompts.zh: 复核我现有的镜头清单和电池架次是否够用
quickPrompts.en: Review my existing shot list and battery plan for gaps

quickPrompts.zh: 只知道拍摄地点和日期时先给核对清单与待查项
quickPrompts.en: With only place and date, list documents and items to verify
